event.title: Former White House Staffer Fined for Insider Betting on Trump Speeches
event.canonical_title: Former White House Staffer Fined for Insider Betting on Trump Speeches
event.summary: A former White House teleprompter operator has been ordered to pay $172,000 after it was determined he used insider knowledge to place bets on President Trump's speeches. The staffer was placed on unpaid leave following the discovery of his actions, which involved betting on the content of the president's remarks.

timeline.title: Former Teleprompter Operator Fined $172,000 for Betting on Trump Speeches
timeline.summary: Gabriel Perez, a former White House teleprompter operator, has been ordered to pay $172,000 after being found to have used insider knowledge of President Trump's speeches to place bets on the Kalshi prediction market. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) reported that he made over $100,000 from these activities.
key_facts: Gabriel Perez was a teleprompter operator at the White House.
He used prior knowledge of Trump's speeches for betting.
The CFTC found he made over $100,000 from these bets.
